name: Yasan – AI Chatbot & Product Search for WooCommerce
author: Yasan

sections.description:
Yasan answers your customers’ questions with an AI shopping assistant that knows your products, orders and policies, and replaces your store’s search box with AI-powered product search.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your Yasan account in one click:

  • It creates the WooCommerce API key Yasan needs, so there is nothing to copy or paste.
  • It adds the Yasan widgets to your storefront once you switch them on in Yasan. There is no theme file to edit and no snippet to paste.
  • Every setting — switching the chatbot and AI Search on and off, their look, their texts — lives in your Yasan account. Changes there show up on your store straight away.

A Yasan account is required. You can create one while connecting. Yasan is a paid service with monthly plans: the first 14 days are free, with no card required. See the plans and prices at https://yasan.ai/pricing.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce, active.
  • Your store served over HTTPS at a public address, so Yasan can reach it.
  • Pretty permalinks (Settings → Permalinks set to anything but “Plain”), which the WordPress REST API routes the plugin uses need.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Yasan (https://yasan.ai/), an AI customer support service operated by Yasan. The plugin talks to the Yasan API at https://app.yasan.ai/api, and your visitors’ browsers load the Yasan widgets from https://app.yasan.ai. Nothing is sent before you click Connect to Yasan.

  • When you click Connect to Yasan, the plugin sends your store’s address, the WordPress admin email, the WooCommerce store country, and a WooCommerce REST API key (read/write) it creates for Yasan. Yasan uses the key to read your products and orders and to answer your customers.
  • While connected, the plugin asks Yasan for the connection status when you open its screen and twice a day in the background, sending only your store’s address and a signature.
  • On your storefront, visitors’ browsers load the Yasan widget script from Yasan’s servers. What visitors type into the chatbot or AI Search is sent to Yasan to answer them.
  • When Yasan’s bot protection is on, the widget runs Cloudflare Turnstile (https://challenges.cloudflare.com), Cloudflare’s check that the visitor is a person and not a bot, as a visitor starts a chatbot or AI Search conversation. Turnstile collects technical data about the visitor’s browser and device for that check. Cloudflare’s Turnstile privacy addendum: https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/, Cloudflare’s terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/
  • When you deactivate or activate the plugin, it tells Yasan to pause or resume your store’s connection, sending only your store’s address and a signature.

  • When you delete the plugin, it tells Yasan to stop using your store.

  • Terms of Service: https://yasan.ai/terms

  • Privacy Policy: https://yasan.ai/privacy
  • Data Processing Agreement: https://yasan.ai/dpa
  • Privacy notice for your store’s visitors: https://yasan.ai/ai-assistant-privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Yasan and click Connect to Yasan.
  3. Sign in to Yasan, or create an account, in the tab that opens, and confirm the connection.
  4. Switch on the chatbot or AI Search in Yasan. They appear on your storefront.
sections.faq:
What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

Your store’s connection to Yasan is paused: the chatbot and AI Search are switched off and product sync stops. Your settings in Yasan stay.

When you activate the plugin again, product sync resumes. The widgets stay off until you switch them back on in your Yasan account, so they never answer from an outdated catalogue.

To disconnect your store for good, delete the plugin.

How do I disconnect my store?

Delete the plugin from the Plugins screen. Yasan is told to stop using your store, and the WooCommerce API key the plugin created is revoked. You can also remove the integration from your Yasan account.

I deleted the Yasan key from WooCommerce’s REST API keys. How do I fix it?

Remove this store’s integration in your Yasan account, then click Connect to Yasan again under WooCommerce → Yasan.

Does the plugin slow down my store?

The storefront gets one small script, loaded asynchronously. The chat interface itself loads only when a visitor is about to use it.

Does it work with page caching plugins?

Yes. The script tag carries no per-visitor data, so cached pages keep working.

1.2.0

  • Deactivating the plugin now pauses your store’s connection to Yasan: the widgets switch off and product sync stops. Activating it again resumes product sync; switch the widgets back on in your Yasan account.

1.1.1

  • Adds the Yasan chatbot and AI Search to the storefront once switched on in Yasan.
